title: Former captain introduces new PPD contact at Base 2

tellings.quote: I was working my regular job and the introduction happened by the previous captain actually showing up at my job

plain: A former sergeant named Dan Sherman, who says the National Security Agency, the US government's electronic intelligence agency, hired him to communicate with aliens, says that sometime between 1990 and 1993 he was handed a new contact for that secret work. He tells it as something he lived: he was doing his regular job at a large base shared by several military services when the captain who had run him before, whom he calls Captain White, simply showed up at his workplace to make the introduction. It matters to his account because it shows the hidden programme running quietly inside an ordinary military posting.
